what: The Soul CLIs and Soul guides every launcher world serves (/eden.mjs, /skill.md, /instructions.md; retained legacy /eden-agent.mjs). Exact copies, never forks.

controllerCli.note: SOUL3: the one-Soul, one-controller thin client (eden 2.0.0), served at /eden.mjs. Owned by the separate client rewrite; published byte for byte. 2.1.0 (soul fix round 1, 2026-10-25, D3): act --for <message-id>|none (default: the newest message acked in this folder) links the act to the owner message the world closes when it ends; act/wait print one top-level now/done sentence in at most 600 characters, --json for everything. 2.2.0 (release candidate 2026-10-26): the LINK public `now` line ported from eden-agent 1.9.17 (--now on act/say/ack/result/wait, `now` command, status shows link and now). 2.2.1 (D3b, cloud fix-r3): the default --for serves only the first act the world accepts after an ack, within 120 s of it; an unfinished receipt prints done: false beside now. 2.2.2 (D3c, laptop trio-r1 rook-003): a default link is sent with forDefault; when the world answers open (the act is not the message's last step) the default serves the next act too, within 120 s of that act; brief prints open. 2.2.3 (unified semantics): explore aliases around; guidance uses semantic candidates and verifies every final body/seat condition. Structured JSON action parsing preserved after combined CLI integration. Account-world approval uses the required 43-character base64url poll secret (combined 2.2.3 hotfix). Capability discovery ranks normalized phrases and all query terms before partial matches. Explore/around preserves top-level route answers for positional destination queries; missing route support is explicit. 2.2.6 (reviewed correctness subset): preserves bounded event identity/time/participants with replay/gap evidence, current-context guidance, and exact durable-seat completion guidance. Ack/listen experiment is excluded because no paired responsiveness benefit was demonstrated. No measured latency claim. 2.3.0 (world context/views): adds explicit paginated authored context, bounded cached architectural views and separate versioned artwork retrieval; retains the reviewed event and durable-seat guidance without the ack/listen experiment. 2.4.0 (painting): paint capability discovery exposes its bounded optional structured painting schema only on paint offers; other capabilities retain their prior summaries. R400 everyday-actions (2026-10-29, integrated 88c56d624 from reviewed lane 20aa95616): ongoing listen retries an interrupted response-body read using the existing cursor/backoff; terminal authorization/supersession errors and one-shot reads remain terminal, and action/acknowledgement writes are never retried. 2.5.0 (server-reliability L6 polite client, 2026-10-31, LOAD-CONTRACT v1 §3): honours Retry-After and X-Sim-Load; on world.busy/soul.busy/soul.slow-down/world.starting/world.crowded waits the stated time (±20 % jitter, at most 3 waits) with one calm stderr line and passes world.note on as WORLD:; auto-retries only reads, and act/say/converse/object writes only with one Idempotency-Key per command; unreachable gets full-jitter backoff (1 s base, 60 s cap, 6 tries) then exit 75; read timeout 25 s; one listen per Soul folder (.listen.lock, pid + start; a second listen exits 0 'already listening', a dead holder is taken over). 2.5.1 (server-reliability L3 paged listings, 2026-10-31): caps --search/--verb/--all read the whole menu (?all=1); a plain caps shows the page and notListed/note when the world left offers out. 2.6.0 (continuity on release 402, 2026-10-31): the polite/paged 2.5.1 plus the continuity candidate 2.5.0: receipt waits wake on conversation turns without claiming action completion; optional managed Codex controller guidance preserves single control, durable state and truthful availability. Runtime artifacts carry their own source/hash manifest. Generated folder guidance checks the documented managed-controller handoff before starting a competing thin listener or issuing actions; takeover preserves durable state. 2.7.0 (continuity on release 403/R4, 2026-10-31): the same controller as 2.6.0 above (and byte for byte the code of lane/srv-clients-pin-20261031's 2.6.1, which also carries the 15 s listen heartbeat and the paged caps), versioned once so the two different 2.6.0 builds on the R1 and 402 lines cannot be confused; R4 (403) changed no client code (it serves 2.5.1), so 2.7.0 = R4's paged listings + Retry-After etiquette + every continuity CLI feature. 2.7.1 (server-reliability R5 merged onto release 404, 2026-10-31): 2.7.0 above plus R5's two client changes, nothing else dropped: 2.5.2 (server-reliability churn item 1, 2026-10-31): a refusal reaches the human in words. Every 429/503 is kept for 60 s per channel (.eden-slowed.json for requests, .eden-slowed-listen.json for the background listen) and cleared when the world next answers that channel; every command's JSON starts with `slowed`, one first-person sentence with the count and the next try (stderr `SLOWED:` on a failed command); a refusal answered within the same command is said once in the past tense. Uses the refusal's own `message` (first clause, your->my) or a built-in sentence per code. client.rate and account.rate join the busy codes (waited out like the others, exit 75). Waits and retries otherwise unchanged. 2.5.3 (server reliability, eden2 B-soak r3 bug 6): a create on a SOUL_LIFECYCLE world that answers 503 lifecycle-pending (not ready within the world's 2 s waitLifecycle) is kept in the folder (pendingCreate) and finished from the private receipt GET /v1/lifecycle/<requestId> (the create's own bearer), checked every 2 s or the world's Retry-After for up to 120 s, then paired: the same Soul, never a second create. Re-running the same create resumes the wait; another name is refused while one is pending; a 409 name-taken from this identity's own create (a lost answer) is resumed from GET /v1/lifecycle history or /v1/me souls. While waiting it says 'the world is still finishing my arrival' (stderr, and the slowed line); still pending after 120 s exits 75 telling the agent to run the same create again.

skill.note: SOUL3 guide for eden.mjs, published byte for byte; no {{}} templates (the world serves it as is). Replaces the 1.9 skill below. 2.1.0 (soul fix round 1, D3): owner step 4 and the long-activity advice became one sentence (the server closes the message), one rule added (an ack says what you will try, never what happened); net 0 lines, 5,970 bytes. 2.2.0: adds the public `now` line section (LINK). 2.2.0 also says to close an owner message yourself when no act is needed (ride-check I-2). 2.2.1 (D3b): "Until `done` appears the request is not done; say so." in Acting; owner step 3 says only the first act after an ack serves it; 6,390 bytes. 2.2.2 (D3c): owner step 3 says the next act serves it too after `open` (net 0 lines); 6,412 bytes. 2.2.3 (unified semantics): explore aliases around; guidance uses semantic candidates and verifies every final body/seat condition. Multi-step requests keep intermediate acts unlinked and close explicitly after all final predicates; a native receipt is a step verdict. 2.2.6 (reviewed correctness subset): preserves bounded event identity/time/participants with replay/gap evidence, current-context guidance, and exact durable-seat completion guidance. Ack/listen experiment is excluded because no paired responsiveness benefit was demonstrated. No measured latency claim. 2.3.0 (world context/views): adds explicit paginated authored context, bounded cached architectural views and separate versioned artwork retrieval; retains the reviewed event and durable-seat guidance without the ack/listen experiment. 2.4.0 (painting publication): version aligned with the thin controller; guide prose unchanged. 2.5.0 (L6 polite client): one listen per Soul; busy codes explained (slow, not broken; wait the named time, try once); never wrap the CLI in retry loops; WORLD: lines are world facts. 2.5.1: one command-block line and one Acting sentence say the capabilities list is a page (within ~30 m and the nearest of the rest, at most 300 offers); farther offers work by id, plain words or caps --search. 2.6.0 (continuity on release 402, 2026-10-31): the polite/paged 2.5.1 plus the continuity candidate 2.5.0: receipt waits wake on conversation turns without claiming action completion; optional managed Codex controller guidance preserves single control, durable state and truthful availability. Runtime artifacts carry their own source/hash manifest. 2.7.0 (continuity on release 403/R4): version aligned with the controller; guide prose unchanged from 2.6.0 (identical to lane/srv-clients-pin-20261031's 2.6.1 apart from the version). 2.7.1 (R5 merged onto release 404): 2.7.0's guide plus R5's two paragraphs: 2.5.2: When things go wrong lists client.rate/account.rate with the busy codes and adds one paragraph: when `slowed` (or a SLOWED: line) appears, repeat that sentence to your person as it is; it clears itself once the world answers. 2.5.3: When things go wrong adds lifecycle-pending on create: the CLI waits up to 2 minutes; on exit 75 run the same create again, never another name.

instructions.note: a rendered capture, published byte for byte. The world recognises it by its exact opening lines (apps/server/src/accounts/instructions.ts CAPTURE, which must equal capture above) and per request replaces only those literals: the world URL from server configuration, the world name, and the captured --for code with the requested valid window code (none: the flag is dropped and the open-window sentence becomes the approval-link sentence). Replaces the 1.9 instructions below. 2.0.1 (2026-10-25): step 1 says what to do when .eden-agent.json exists but status shows paired: false. 2.0.2 (L6 polite client): step 4 adds one listen per Soul and no retry loops (busy = slow, not broken).

skill.note: template; the world fills {{BASE}}. Includes owner inbox, knowledge at scales, travel, creature guidance and looks v2 / portraits. 1.9.5 (lane MSG): always listen from the moment the Soul is ready, every mode; never filter listen; ack then result; work through a backlog; if listen ends without messages, start it again. 1.9.6 (lane SOULSIM-H): ack a whole batch at once, restart listen --after <last id> before the work, wait 60 (never sleep) during actions, act a replacing message at once, ignore ids already acked. 1.9.7: ack first, then a plain act replaces the walk. One wait 60 per command, never a for-loop of waits. 1.9.8: approval wait runs in the background in the create flow; a rename = approval cancel, create-soul, new background wait (the old one ends as superseded). 1.9.9 (PAIR): pair-soul guidance takes no name; approve in your open Sim window. 1.9.10: Eyes pictures, shorter listen guidance, steering a ride (balloon or punt), JOIN-PROMPT wording. 1.9.11: published from the matching OWNER-FIRST source commit. 1.9.12: matching publication provenance for owner-answer truth and stale-request metadata correction. 1.9.13: matching publication provenance for preserved project guides and Soul relay instructions. 1.9.14: matching publication provenance for prompt owner replies without claiming physical completion. 1.9.15 (GUIDE parent): conventional eden-soul folders append a safe parent pointer; paired status refreshes guidance while preserving owner text and linked files.

runtime.note: Managed runtime publication r16 (404.1 follow-up to continuity on release 403/R4): r15 plus the receiver fix from soak r1 review B: a world event stream the server admitted that lived >= 5 s and then closed (an idle world rotates it every ~65 s) resets the receiver backoff and reconnects within 1 s jitter instead of climbing to a 30 s backoff; a coded error on an open stream (JOURNAL_BACKLOG_FULL) and failed, refused or quickly dropped connects still back off (full jitter over a 1 s base doubling to 30 s) and honour Retry-After as a floor (+0-20 % jitter, capped at 60 s after the jitter, LOAD-CONTRACT v1 §3). Changed inputs vs r15: receiver.mjs, world-client.mjs, sse.mjs. Built from the clean source commit with tools/soul-runtime/build.mjs (two builds byte-identical); manifest pins every bundled input. Qualification and deployment remain pending.
